title: Cabana Fever Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Similar to the bright and refreshing colors of Florida beach cottages of the 1940s is the cozy 'Cabana Fever' Seaside cottage, located just three houses past 30-A and only a short stroll to the beach pavilion or sparkling blue pool of the west side.
description_expanded: 32 NATCHEZ STREETA Vintage Seaside Cottage with Iconic 30A HistoryInspired by the bright, refreshing palette of Florida beach cottages from the 1940s, Cabana Fever is a one-of-a-kind Seaside vacation rental located just three homes from Scenic Highway 30A and only 78 steps from the sugar-white sands of Seaside’s private beach. Situated on historic Natchez Street, this charming one-story Seaside cottage holds a special place in town history—it was the first home ever built on Natchez Street and even played a small role in The Truman Show, sitting directly across from the iconic Truman House.With beach access just moments from your front door and the West Side community pool a short stroll away, Cabana Fever offers an unbeatable location in the heart of Seaside, Florida.Thoughtful Design with Vintage Coastal CharacterInside, Cabana Fever is filled with personality and soul. The cottage features one-of-a-kind vintage rattan furnishings, classic 1940s club chairs, and carefully selected contemporary accents that blend seamlessly with its retro coastal charm. Nautical-inspired artwork, antique details, and whimsical pop-culture touches create a space that feels collected, personal, and undeniably Seaside. Vintage aquarium collectibles add a playful finishing touch throughout the home.Modern Comforts with Timeless Florida StyleA comprehensive renovation in 2012 thoughtfully updated Cabana Fever with modern appliances, upgraded electronics, and refreshed interiors, while preserving the cheerful spirit of an old-time Florida beach cottage. Enhancements include a cozy fireplace, beautifully updated bathrooms with marble countertops and classic subway tile, and abundant natural light from a skylight and bay window. Newly painted interiors reflect the deep blues and vibrant tones of the nearby Gulf, bringing the outdoors in.Comfortable Sleeping Accommodations for FamiliesCabana Fever offers three bedrooms and two and a half bathrooms, making it ideal for families or small groups. The primary bedroom features a king bed and a private ensuite bathroom with a separate soaking tub and walk-in shower. A welcoming queen guest bedroom and a third bedroom with twin bunk beds provide flexible sleeping options and share a conveniently located hall bathroom that connects directly to the guest room.Outdoor Living Just Steps from the BeachStep outside to enjoy classic Seaside outdoor living. The rear deck serves as the home’s grilling and relaxing hub, perfect for casual dinners after a day at the beach. An outdoor shower makes rinsing off sandy toes effortless, letting you transition seamlessly from beach time to evening relaxation.Bonus Guest Cottage for Added FlexibilityFor those traveling with extended family or friends, Cabana Fever offers an added bonus—the charming guest cottage known as Cabana Babe, which can accommodate two additional guests. This unique setup provides extra privacy while keeping everyone close together, making Cabana Fever an excellent option for larger groups seeking a shared Seaside escape.A Classic Seaside Getaway on 30AWith its rich history, unbeatable proximity to the beach, and joyful blend of vintage style and modern comfort, Cabana Fever is a truly special Seaside, Florida vacation rental. Whether you’re planning a family beach getaway or looking to unwind in a storied coastal retreat, this ocean-side cottage invites you to slow down, soak up the sunshine, and melt the stress away—Seaside style.* Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum Winter.FEATURES1,488 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space174 feet or a 1-minute walk to beach accessPrivate Seaside residential beach at Natchez Pavilion, the largest private residential beach on 30AAll on one level for easy, comfortable livingWasher & dryer conveniently located in the homePeacock Alley Linens – fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughoutEnclosed outdoor shower for rinsing off after beach daysAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities provided2 parking passes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit. No pets allowed STR23-001907
